## 🐛 Bug Summary
A clear and concise description of the issue:
> Example: "CalradiaForge fails to detect newly installed mods after restart."


> **Note:** During investigation, you may be asked to temporarily **enable Debug Mode in Settings, restart CalradiaForge, and then reproduce the issue again** so that more detailed diagnostic information is captured in the logs.

---

## ✅ Prerequisites

Please confirm the following before submitting:

- [ ] I am using the **latest released version** of CalradiaForge
- [ ] I have checked the existing **[Issues](https://github.com/ThelianTech-Studios/CalradiaForge/issues)** and did not find a duplicate
- [ ] I have read the **README** and in-app **FAQ** for known issues and workarounds

---

## 💻 Environment

- **CalradiaForge version:**  
  (From the **About** panel, e.g. `v0.4.1-beta`)

- **OS version:**  
  (e.g. `Windows 10 22H2 x64`, `Windows 11 23H2 x64`)

- **Game platform:**  
  - [ ] Steam  
  - [ ] GOG / Standalone  
  - [ ] Epic Games (not supported yet)  
  - [ ] GamePass (not supported yet)

- **Bannerlord version:**  
  (e.g. `v1.2.9`, `v1.3.0 beta`)

- **Install location of Bannerlord:**  
  (Example: `C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Mount & Blade II Bannerlord`)

- **Install location of CalradiaForge:**  
  (Example: `D:\Games\CalradiaForge`)

## 📸 Screenshots / Screen Recording (Optional)

If applicable, add screenshots or a short screen recording that shows the issue.

- Screenshots:
  - Drag & drop images here, or paste.
- Recording:
  - Provide a link (e.g. unlisted YouTube, Streamable, etc.)

## 📁 Logs & Diagnostic Files

For **all text files, logs, or large attachments**, please **upload them to a file host** and paste links instead of inlining the content.

Recommended options:

- GitHub Gist (preferred for logs / text): https://gist.github.com  
- Private file/link sharing (e.g. OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.)

> Make sure links are accessible and (if needed) set to "Anyone with the link can view".

**Log & file links (one per line):**

- Logs (CalradiaForge log files):  
  - `https://...`
- Modpack definitions / config / other files:  
  - `https://...`

- [ ] I have uploaded relevant logs / text files to an external host
- [ ] I have removed/obfuscated any personal or sensitive information from the uploaded files

To find the logs:

1. Open the **Logs** directory (see README: *Directories & Data Locations*).
2. Locate the most recent log files (e.g. `CalradiaForge.log`, `CalradiaForge_YYYYMMDD.log`).
3. Upload them and paste the public **view/download links** above.

---

## 📦 Mods / Modpacks Context

If the issue is related to mods or modpacks, please complete:

- **Approximate number of mods installed:**  
- **Mod source(s):**  
  - [ ] NexusMods
  - [ ] Steam Workshop (manually exported)
  - [ ] Other (please specify):

- **Are you using modpacks?**
  - [ ] Yes
  - [ ] No

- **If yes, does the issue occur with:**
  - [ ] A specific modpack only
  - [ ] All modpacks
  - [ ] Even with a minimal/vanilla+ setup

If possible, upload a **sample modpack file** that reproduces the issue and add its link in the logs section above.

---

## ⚠️ Error Messages

If any error dialog, Windows event, or console output is shown:

- Exact error text (copy/paste if short), or upload as a text file and link it:
    <paste short error text here, or say "see linked logs/error file">

- Screenshot(s) of the error dialog (optional):

---

## 🔍 Additional Details

Any additional context that might be relevant:

- Recent changes before the issue started (new mods, game updates, CalradiaForge update, OS updates, etc.)
- Whether the issue is intermittent or 100% reproducible
- Whether it occurs only after a fresh app start, or also after multiple sessions

---

## 🧪 Minimal Reproduction (If Possible)

If you can, describe the **smallest possible setup** that still reproduces the issue:

- Minimal set of mods or a specific mod
- Specific steps or configuration
- Anything disabled/removed that is *not* required to trigger the bug

This is optional but highly valuable for debugging.
